a.verifiedClaim: Bone-facing ruffled membrane acidifies the resorption compartment through proton transport.

b.verifiedClaim: Hydroxyapatite dissolution consumes protons and releases calcium; this distinguishes mineral release from acid secretion.

locators: Printed p227 and pp231–232 (PDF pp2,6–7), Introduction/Discussion
c.verifiedClaim: Osteoclast chloride/bicarbonate exchange removes intracellular alkaline equivalents and supports cytoplasmic pH regulation, a role distinct from lacunar proton secretion. The experiment does not itself locate every transporter on the exam diagram.

locators: Printed p227 (PDF p2), Introduction, calcium hydroxyapatite composition
d.verifiedClaim: Phosphate belongs to the bone mineral context; it is distinguished from the proton delivered for acidification. No claim is made that phosphate can never cross an osteoclast membrane.

questions.diagramInterpretation: The official AM10 diagram contains erythrocytes in a lumen. This is an observation of the recovered diagram, not a newly assigned official answer.

a.verifiedClaim: Plasma cells produce antibodies and are individual immune cells, distinct from a vascular lumen.

locators: PLOS Introduction, Fig1d, Discussion and Fig3/CD31
b.verifiedClaim: Granulation tissue contains new capillaries lined by endothelial cells; capillaries are small blood vessels. The official diagram provides the lumen/erythrocyte observation.

c.verifiedClaim: Lymphocytes are immune white blood cells, not the name of a vessel structure.

locators: PLOS Discussion, fibroblast and collagen network paragraphs
d.verifiedClaim: Fibroblasts deposit collagen in the wound matrix. Fibrous extracellular matrix is distinguished from endothelial blood vessel structures.

locators: Ann Jpn Prosthodont Soc10(2018), pp16–18, Introduction/Basic principles
a.verifiedClaim: Gothic arch tracing records mandibular movements to establish horizontal jaw relations. This is distinguished by what it records from direct muscle activity assessment.

locators: Abstract, Materials and methods; Fig3, Fig4–6; Table3
b.verifiedClaim: Checkbite records protrusive/lateral jaw relations and is used to determine condylar inclinations on a semi-adjustable articulator. It can assess mandibular movement parameters indirectly, so the pairing is not declared categorically false.

c.verifiedClaim: Palatograms document tongue-palatal contact during speech and are used to assess articulation.

locators: Printed p367, Introduction/Abstract; pp368–369, Methods2-2 and3
d.verifiedClaim: The study scans upper and lower dentitions, performs bite registration and measures digital tooth morphology to support dentition/occlusion analysis.
